origin.description: Piecewise polynomial with one polynomial on each break interval.

arguments.name: P
arguments.text: One coefficient row per piece, highest power first.

origin.details: Breaks 0, 1, 2 and rows (1, 0) and (2, 1). The check vector is breaks, coefficients column by column, pieces, order, and dim.
origin.value: Piecewise polynomial with one polynomial on each break interval.
origin.example: local({z <- mkpp(c(0, 1, 2), rbind(c(1, 0), c(2, 1))); c(z$breaks, z$coefs, z$pieces, z$order, z$dim)})
